messages:
marta: quick note 2: rolling a consensus-style canary for v4-int4 on qa/rerank + extract slices. want to lock a fallback rule for cross-model disagreement.
jeno: whats the failure mode we worry about? hallucination, missing spans, or answer ordering?
marta: mainly missing spans + rerank swaps. different decodes disagree on top-3 for extract tasks.
kai: can we use a voting fraction across 3 variants (fp16 control, int4 candidate, int4-alt-kv) and trigger if candidate loses majority AND utility metrics drop?
marta: exactly. sketching gate: majority_loss AND metric_drop. add min_samples and min_slice_traffic.
jeno: also add a tie-breaker: if candidate ties with alt-kv but fp16 wins, prefer safe fallback. require bootstrap CI.
marta: draft YAML: 
```yaml
gate:
  name: consensus-fallback-watchdog
  ensemble_members: ["control-fp16", "candidate-int4", "candidate-int4-altkv"]
  decision_rule:
    - name: majority_loss
      comparator: fraction
      threshold: 0.5
      target: candidate-int4
      min_samples: 1200
  metrics:
    - name: exact_match
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -4.0
      min_samples: 1200
    - name: rerank_mrr
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -3.0
  cohort_filter:
    slices: ["extract/span", "rerank/shortquery"]
    min_traffic_pct: 1.5
  safety:
    require_bootstrap_ci: true
    consecutive_windows: 2
    latency_check: p95
    latency_margin_ms: 15
  action:
    on_violation: rollback_candidate
    notify: ["#oncall", "#eng-ml"]
    create_issue: true
    cooldown_after_manual: 2h
```
kai: +1. Add an automated microshadow that replays disagreeing samples to candidate-int4-altkv with ttl=120s; if altkv recovers >70% of disagreements, mark cause as warmup/kv.
ops-bot: deploybot: consensus canary shadow started 4321987700 region-us-west
eval-bot: eval-bot: window1 complete -> majority_loss fraction 0.62 for candidate-int4, exact_match delta -5.4% (95% CI [-6.8,-3.9]), rerank_mrr -3.8%, affected slices weight 1.9%
marta: looks like gate conditions met; but we require two windows. starting investigative microshadow per kai. tagging @jeno @kai
jeno: opening rollback issue and pausing any promote. will attach diffs and request postmortem if microshadow doesn't explain it.
marta: thanks. I'll push gate config to canary repo and schedule longer shadow 200k samples tomorrow.
